title: もう何もいらない未来
use: 非剧中使用(单曲/专辑曲)
lines: 刻んだ夜を縫い合わせた

眩しいままの淡い記憶
破った　切り裂いた
適当に頷いて
流れに逆らうことないように
見え透いている
その　目的地まで
息苦しい　地図は平気で縮まって
それでも逃げられなくて　ただ　俯いた
嘘ついてばっかり

ほら　夢を見たんだろう

もういらない　何もかも

ああ　もっと毒を吐き出せ

それらしい形を手に取ったんだ
あれからずっと　ほら　水色の中

また　消えてゆく

遠くまで聴こえるはずの呼び音
意味なんかないまま
投げつけた　この世の間違いを
この空に託した夢のこと
遠くで瞬く何もかも
いつだって忘れはしないよ
世界はどうにか続いている
君に触れていた
もういらない　何もかも

可我早已心知肚明
这不过是为了通向目的地

口中满是虚伪谎言
那就用早已冻结的双唇呐喊
看吧 你不也是曾有过梦想吗

都抛弃吧 全部的所有

才伸手抓住了貌似合理的形态
从那之后始终浸在 看吧 这水色之中
被无形的流线 所缠绕身躯
吐露着那些无聊的台词
可它 却再次消逝
空无一物的深海
呐喊本该能抵达远方
可依旧毫无意义
将这世间的谬误狠狠掷还
连同那托付给天空的梦想
那些遥远闪烁的点点光亮
我永远都不会忘记
世界仍在苟延残喘
连带与你相伴的记忆

带着几近消散的影子 再次前行
越过涟漪嶙峋的水面彼端
仍残留着温热与冰冷
我们终将抵达 直至永恒尽头

en: I stitched together the nights I carved in
every single shattered truth
faint memories still blinding bright
I tore them, I slashed them apart
Nodding along half-heartedly
so as never to go against the flow
It's all so transparent
all the way to that destination
It's suffocating - the map shrinks without a care
Still I can't escape, so I just hung my head
Nothing but lies
Scream with those frozen lips
See, you had a dream, didn't you
That place smashed to pieces
that endlessly clear, open place
I don't need it anymore - none of it
Pretty words, two-faced lies
Let's go find the real future
Ah, spit out more poison
Beasts, idle nonsense
The blue pain nesting in my chest
I'll pick it up carefully
The real me is right here
I'll surely never be forgiven
Even so, this now that isn't fiction
What I lost, what I gained
Scatter it all with those filthy hands
That's right - the arrow is right here
Wanting to know the right answer
I picked up something that looked like one
Ever since then, look, inside the water blue
Invisible streamlines coil around my body
Spitting out worthless lines
and fading away again
Empty, a deep sea
A call that should carry far away
still meaning nothing at all
I hurled the mistakes of this world
and the dream I entrusted to this sky
everything twinkling far away
I will never forget, not ever
The world somehow keeps going
I was touching you
I don't need it anymore - none of it
Pretty words, two-faced lies
Let's go find the real future
Ah, spit out more poison
Beasts, idle nonsense
The blue pain nesting in my chest
I'll pick it up carefully
The real me is right here
I'll surely never be forgiven
Even so, this now that isn't fiction
A shadow about to vanish - go once more
Beyond the rough, gritted water's surface
Still warm, and still cold
I'll keep tracing it, anywhere, forever
What I lost, what I gained
Scatter it all with those filthy hands
That's right - the arrow is right here
